newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Safilo buys 10 pct of Elegance.
newsitem.headline: Safilo buys 10 pct of Elegance.

text.p: Elegance International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its parent Best Quality Ltd had reached a conditional agreement to sell a 9.99 percent stake in Elegance International to Safilo SpA for HK$30.99 million.
The sale of the 27.67 million shares at HK$1.12 per share would reduce Best Quality's stake in Elegance International to about 51 percent from 61 percent, the company said in a statement.
Italy's Safilo will also have an option to subscribe to new shares representing 10 percent of Elegance International's enlarged share capital.
The option commences in a year and lasts for one year.
A second subscription option, which kicks in a year after the first option is exercised, allows Elegance International to subscribe to a further five percent of the enlarged share capital.
Elegance International said Safilo would hold the stake for long term investment and its parent Best Quality had no intention to further reducing its stake in the company.
The company also said it would set up a joint venture with Safilo to exploit the China market and to sell its products through Safilo's worldwide distribution network.
Trading in Elegance International shares, which was suspended on Monday, is due to resume on Tuesday. The stock last traded at HK$1.33.
Elegance International designs, makes and sells optical frames and sunglasses. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
